name: Talisman of the Sphere

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: Doubles your Proficiency Bonus on Arcana checks to control a Sphere of Annihilation, with Advantage.
text: While holding or wearing this talisman, you double your Proficiency Bonus on Intelligence (Arcana) checks you make to control a Sphere of Annihilation, and you have Advantage on such checks. In addition, when you start your turn in control of a Sphere of Annihilation, you can take a Magic action to levitate it 10 feet plus a number of additional feet equal to 10 times your Intelligence modifier.
